'''Subscape Communications''' was a large company based in the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] that provided communications access for individuals along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade routes]]. The company was owned by the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]].<ref name="SSR" />
